desc: Gravity numerator flipped to (q - q_star): attraction becomes repulsion
4D progress uses max(1.0, ...) instead of min: progress is always >= 1 after one session (instant graduation)
Mask law inverted (=== false): unmasked actors become anonymous, masked actors get the grudge
Zero-G stability gate passes when S_stab <= 0.50 (unstable craft pass, stable ones fail); planetary branch still uses >= 0.50
Reputation update uses (S + 0.5): every day raises reputation, it can never fall (neutral point lost)
E_max set to 1,200 MPa (1.2 GPa) while the same section spans Diamond at 1050 GPa
Inverse density map divides by ln(rho_max) instead of ln(rho_max/rho_min): V_tx(rho(V)) != V, not a bijection
Local offset stored as Float16Array: spacing at 512 m is 0.5 m, contradicting the sub-millimetre precision claim
Archetype table lists #11 twice (Enchantress and Hanged Man); #12 is missing from the Body complex 8..14
VSA-4096 stated as Uint32Array(64) = 2048 bits / 256 bytes, not 4096 bits / 512 bytes
